notes.title: Patch 1.6
notes.notes: [h3]Hello again pilots![/h3][p]We are back with a new update. Once again we are improving the core of the game. I wanted to restructure certain basics and with that add [b]Critical Damage[/b] and [b]Critical Chance[/b].[/p][p]Another big change is the "[b]boss[/b]" levels/stars for enemies, yes, now after a certain level, enemies will start to have a higher chance of being tougher.[/p][p]New [b]plasma weapon[/b] available for purchase at the main station and smugglers.[/p][p]Asteroid loot has been changed so that they all drop some material, at the request of some players who thought it would be more fun to be able to farm on all of them. With this change there is also a chance to find diamonds and iron.[/p][p]This change also introduces direct damage to asteroids, [u]not all weapons will be able to mine minerals[/u].[/p][p]The wave mode has new upgrades and the level cap of some of them is up to [b]999[/b]. So you will be able to fight to the end, or so I hope.[/p][p][/p][p]So far an overall of all the changes in this [b]RECALIBRATION[/b] update. I'll be keeping an eye on social media and Steam's internal forums for any issues that arise.[/p][p][/p][p][b]See you next time! 🙌[/b][/p][h3]  [/h3][h3]Patch Notes[/h3][p]*[b]NEW[/b]: Critical Damage & Critical Chance.[/p][p]*[b]NEW[/b]: Improved mining with new items and better loot system.[/p][p]*[b]NEW[/b]: Diamonds, Iron Minerals.[/p][p]*[b]NEW[/b]: Enemy stars (1 to 3 boss levels).[/p][p]*[b]NEW[/b]: Plasma Gun Tiers (1-2).[/p][p]*[b]NEW[/b]: Many more improvements for waves mode.[/p][p]*[b]NEW[/b]: Upgrade system inside the hangar.[/p][p][/p][p]*[b]CHG[/b]: Loot modified to support TIERS and STAR.[/p][p]*[b]CHG[/b]: Mineral loot more rewarding when leveling up weapons.[/p][p]*[b]CHG[/b]: Enemy ships don't drop LOOT when hitting rocks.[/p][p]*[b]CHG[/b]: Overall balance of all weapons.[/p][p]*[b]CHG[/b]: Complete balancing of sectors to make them more complex and with more rewards.[/p][p]*[b]CHG[/b]: Modified purchase items in smugglers.[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug-fixes[/h3][p]*[b]FIX[/b]: Functional Tiers system on asteroids and turrets.[/p][p]*[b]FIX[/b]: Solved infinite lives in mayhem and only 10 (max)[/p][p]*[b]FIX[/b]: Smugglers cannot be opened in normal mode.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello again pilots![/h3]

Finally the update I've been talking about. [b]Steam Deck[/b] support. It has taken some time to arrive but I will take advantage of the spring release to make the 1.5 update that not only includes [b]Steam Deck[/b] support.

Finally, stalkers are active on the map again. Be careful now if you go uranium mining because they will be waiting to hunt you down.

Mayhem mode is now much more challenging than before. The enemy spawn system has been improved so they don't take as long to get to you (I'll probably have to make progression adjustments later).

Made a few tweaks to spawn times and fixed a few things that you'll see in the patch notes.


[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
* Hunter Stalker active again in search of uranium.
* Mayhem mode is now much more challenging.
* Option to sell all inventory items - shop.
* Autoaim is now configurable from the options menu.
* Increased turn speed during autoaim.

[h3]Bug-fixes[/h3]
* FIX: problem when opening smuggler window with controllers.

notes.title: Hotfix for linux users!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello again pilots![/b]

Thanks to some colleagues, I have detected that in Linux and Steam Deck, Space Battle did not appear correctly to download and only came out with 0B. After analyzing the problem I have corrected it and it should be ready to enjoy on both platforms.

If you experience any issues, please report them in the Steam Discussions.

Finally the surprise is out. Space Battle will be released on Nintendo Switch on April 1st, 2025. That's why the last updates were in forced steps and without big changes to avoid friction. I'll leave the link to various eShop locations but it should be available everywhere by now.

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello again pilots![/h3]

[i]I'm really happy with the state of the game at the end of the year. The evolution of the game has been remarkable and everything was easy, just filling in the gaps that I planned one day.[/i]

I wanted to prepare changes that affect the gameplay to finally make it a complicated experience. In the end the Invasion system is the final transition of an idea that has been evolving for a long time.

The invasion system will add the final difficulty needed to take action in the short term or you will be defeated in a very short time.

With the invasion mode I begin to bring Space Battle full circle, all these updates have been closing chapters of handwritten features one day and there are few left.

I hope you enjoy another great update and start this year with a bang!

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
* [b]INVASION system.[/b]
* Dragon turrets with new sprites ready.
* [b]Traditional Chinese.[/b]
* Incremental tiers per kill system applied to turrets, the more times you destroy it, the stronger it gets.
* Station can be repaired in blocks of 100 and not all at once.
* Enemy ships are more efficient.
* Added tier 3 stations.
* Modified time values to 120 and 30 again (very slow gameplay).


[h3]Bug-fixes[/h3]
* FIX: Problem when exiting with boss enemy bars.
* FIX: Station life buy button can now be pressed multiple times.
* FIX: Fixed UI bug with life and shield values.
* FIX: Some sounds were not heard correctly.
* FIX: Improved enemy detection system (before it didn't detect shots).

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1
notes.notes:

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
[b]Hello pilots![/b]

Another new update. Although I haven't been able to add a lot of things.... I'll make a pretty important announcement soon, for now I can only say that I'm working on a [b]side mission[/b]. 

The main thing is that you can [u]now upgrade your ship[/u] from the main station. It still needs some balancing... And I'm probably going to modify its location, but it's fun to see how it works.

Several problems with the controllers have been solved. I keep improving the enemy AI although it is still a bit slow. I have added a new sector with more elements and a new smuggler. 

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3] 
* [b]Progression for the player: purchase of upgrades in main station.[/b]
* AI Brain to improve the intelligence of the ships.
* Sector 39 introduced and NECO the collector.
* Localization for several levels.
* Portals have the name of the sector you travel to.
* New turrets (Dual and Guided Cannons).
* Life main station in HUD.

[h3]Bug-fixes[/h3]
* Loss of all the credits in the beacons.
* Minor bug fixes on controllers.

notes.title: Patch 1.2 - CONTROLLERS
notes.notes:
[b]Hello pilots![/b]

And this time a new update to work on that accessibility. The controllers is something I've been working on little by little but until now I haven't dedicated time to improve all the systems and have a good support. I will be making adjustments during the rest of the month, but this is the main work so far.

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3] 
* Xbox Controller & Gamepads support.
* Revised Zoom IN/OUT.
* Increased safe time range from 120s - 180s (up to 3 minutes) - Normal Mode.
* Increased alert time range (30s-60s) - Normal Mode.
* In-game controls help (can be hidden from options). - Hints.
* Added configuration needed to move Universal Windows Platform.

[h3]Bug-fixes[/h3]

* Removed old input system icons.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 - SMUGGLERS AND WEAPONS
notes.notes:
[b]Hello pilots![/b]

A new version just out of the oven. After the release of 1.0, I wanted to implement several pending adjustments that, due to lack of time, I couldn't add before. The [b]smugglers[/b] are an element that has been in and out of the game until now. You will finally be able to trade in other sectors; for now they only offer new weapons, but over time they will have special discounts on various items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37731299/14bea830b6f0e30845eb87ca3db35230558bb317.png[/img]

- TIER 1,2,3,4 and 5 weapons added. Higher TIER weapons are to be found in distant sectors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37731299/ab91f76447eeaa687e8d893fc22c26ad64927f94.png[/img]

[i]I've also added the precious rocks - we don't know what they're for yet, but they're there.[/i]

Enemy stations now have a health bar at the top to make it easier to see how much health they have left.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37731299/2e612a98b463911fd0fd9f6d09433c8f0c3054ed.png[/img]

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3] 
*Smugglers added.
*New weapons as initial player progression Gun (Tier 2, 3, 4, 5), Laser (Tier 2, 3, 4, 5).
*RYNO is no longer available in central sector.

*Added life bar (final boss) to enemy stations.
*Adjusted sector 13 portal price.
*Modified main station UI.
*Modified colliders main station.
*Inventory shows TIER of items and if they are equipped.
*Added game mode description to main menu.
*Stones added to loot (don't know what for yet, but there are stones).
*Modified player propellant.

[h3]Bug-fixes[/h3]

*Fixed major issue when equipping weapons.
*Fixed major issue with going through portals removing all your credits.

notes.title: Patch 1.0 - Portals!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello pilots![/b]

At last! After such a long time, version 1.0 is here. It's taken a while but along the way we did the Epic Games Store release and a lot of bug fixing. I'm pleased to say that we'll finally have the portals to travel between sectors, I'll be making improvements to the system over time. The Stalkers are active again to hunt you down and finally... Yes, finally... Achievements! 40 to be exact. I hope you enjoy the release and as always I'll be checking your feedback to fix issues.

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3] 
*Portals 
*Achievements, lots of achievements 
*Stalkers are back on the hunt 
*Added nuclear reactors as special loot to enemy stations 
*Improved mining system (Different resources depending on sector) 
*Modified starting enemy space station location (Less pressure on new players)

[h3]Bug-fixes[/h3]

*Solved problem with hit numbers on turrets and ships *Beacons now have a chance to hit.

notes.title: Patch 0.9 - DLC Mayhem is out!
notes.notes:
Something is moving in deep space and you don't have your space station to help you anymore... The Mayhem DLC adds a new Bullet Hell style game mode where you will have to endure as many waves as possible. It was planned for release on June 10th but I'd rather have feedback soon so I can work out the kinks.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2808620/Space_Battle__Mayhem/

There are still some details to polish and improvements that will be applied to the base game as well as the DLC. I don't want to publish a roadmap with all the changes but I can say that soon the game will be available in the [b]EPIC GAMES STORE[/b] and I will be busy making the necessary modifications as well as upgrading to [b]Unity 6[/b], so patches will be common.

https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/spacebattle-d27e87


Although I mention it in the DLC description itself I will mention again that purchasing the DLC is completely optional. I wanted to investigate the process involved in making DLC, the technical and bureaucratic aspects. On the other hand, it is impossible to improve the content of indie games without funding, so with the purchase of the DLC you are helping to maintain the game and future games, which I anticipate, there are little things prepared, once again thanks for joining me in the space adventures.

- [i]Adrián Corbalán[/i]

[b]Patch notes[/b]
*Mayhem game mode available as additional content.
*Frances in game support.
*Revamped main game mode UI.
*Vsync and frame limit added to settings.
*Added options: Vsync, frame limit, resolution, fullscreen.
*Enemy progression system by tiers active.
*Shield loot.
*Modified icons for items (Credits, Ammo, Health, Health, Shields).
*Permanent death mode active again.
*Upgrade to Unity 2023.3.3f1.
*Confirmation windows.
*Bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.7
notes.notes:
Finally a "major" update for Space Battle!

After the announcement of this year's roadmap, many internal modifications have been made to be up to date with this Patch 0.7. Among them upgrading to the latest version of Unity 2023 has delayed the release a bit.

I will support several languages that I have seen a higher volume of users although not all of them are 100% confirmed translations, I have used third-party tools for this.

On the other hand already available for wishlist the DLC - MAYHEM which will include a new game mode, release expected for June 2024.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2808620/Space_Battle__Mayhem/
